page_title: DOR 1-0 WOL | Dortmund v Wolfsburg 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A corner kick by Wolfsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Gregor Kobel (Dortmund).
90+5' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. Wolfsburg have a corner.
90+4' It seemed like Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+3' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Wolfsburg get a free kick.
90+3' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90+2' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) replacing Marcel Sabitzer.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
88' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
88' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

87' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Dortmund will take a corner kick.
86' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Substitution. Joakim Maehle will be replaced by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
78' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
77' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Felix Nmecha will be replaced by Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund).
77' Substitution. Karim Adeyemi did his best and is replaced by Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
76' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

76' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. Dortmund force their opponents to concede a corner.
75' The attendance for today's match is 81365.
75' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) replaces Patrick Wimmer.
73' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
72' Carney Chukwuemeka almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.

67' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Gregor Kobel!
65' Substitution. Maximilian Beier is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund).
60' Paul Simonis prepares a substitution. Vini Souza is replaced by Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg).
60' Today's match ends for Lovro Majer who will be replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
59' The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
59' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.

56' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Daniel Svensson, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
52' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
51' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes it short.

51' The linesman makes the right call and Dortmund will have a corner. Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
49' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Gregor Kobel comes off the line to clear the ball away.
47' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Kamil Grabara is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
46' Dortmund failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Paul Simonis has decided to make a change. Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) replaces Andreas Skov Olsen.
46' Referee Daniel Siebert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

44' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
41' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
38' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
37' Daniel Siebert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg).
34' What a chance that is! Julian Ryerson swings the ball into the box, and Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
34' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
32' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.
29' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

28' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) decides to try his luck with a first-time bullet of a shot. Unfortunately for him, he doesn't hit the ball perfectly and his effort ends well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
25' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

20' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Kamil Grabara just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
18' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
18' A pass from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is intercepted by Kamil Grabara and the move breaks down.
17' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
15' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

11' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniel Siebert with no other option than to blow for a foul.
10' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
9' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
5' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
5' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
4' The corner from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is hurriedly cleared.
4' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
Wolfsburg will kick-off.
Daniel Siebert is the one to supervise the game today.
